## Terms of Use

The Company's Terms of Use were updated in October 2025.

Welcome to Ludus. By accessing and using our platform, you agree to the terms and conditions below.

___

### 1. Acceptance of the Terms

___

-	Accounts may be suspended in cases of fraud, rule violations, or misuse.

Some services may require payment or subscription.

___

### 8. Changes to the Terms

We may update these Terms periodically. The updated version will always be available on the website, and continued use implies acceptance.

privacy.__content__:
## Privacy Policy

The Company's Privacy Policy was updated in October 2025.

Ludus values the privacy and protection of its users' personal data. This Privacy Policy aims to protect the fundamental rights of freedom and privacy and the free development of the natural person's personality. The Company has prepared this Privacy Policy in compliance with the provisions of the General Data Protection Law (LGPD) - Law No. 13,709/2018.

___

### 1. Data Collected

We collect the following types of data:

a) Registration data: full name, email, password, CPF, RG, date of birth, phone number, and address.

b) Payment data: credit card information, purchase history, and transactions (securely stored via payment partners).

c) Browsing data: IP address, access date and time, cookies, device identifiers, and platform usage logs.

d) Sensitive data: identity documents (RG, CPF, CNH), when required for identity verification, event security, or compliance with legal obligations.

___

### 2. Purpose of Processing

Data is used to:
-	Create and manage user accounts;
-	Enable participation in games and events;
-	Process payments and issue receipts;
- Provide technical support and customer service;
-	Send communications about updates, promotions, and events (with consent);
-	Comply with legal obligations and prevent fraud.

___

### 3. Legal Basis

Data processing is carried out based on the following legal grounds under the LGPD:
- Performance of a contract (art. 7, V);
-	Compliance with a legal obligation (art. 7, II);
-	Data subject consent (art. 7, I);
-	Legitimate interest (art. 7, IX).

___

### 4. Data Sharing

We may share data with:
-	Payment partners (e.g., financial intermediaries);
-	Digital security companies (for fraud prevention);
-	Public authorities, when required by law;
-	Service providers that assist in operating the platform (hosting, support, email, etc.).

All partners follow security and confidentiality standards compatible with the LGPD.

___

### 5. Storage and Security

Data is stored on protected servers and accessed only by authorized personnel. We adopt technical and administrative measures to prevent unauthorized access, leaks, or loss.

___

### 6. Data Subject Rights
The user may, at any time:

- Confirm the existence of data processing;
- Access, correct, delete, or request anonymization of data;
- Revoke previously given consent;
- Request data portability to another provider.

Requests may be made via email: ludus.auratus@gmail.com

___

### 7. Data Retention

Data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the stated purposes and legal obligations (such as tax or contractual requirements).

___

### 8. Data Protection Officer (DPO)

The person responsible for personal data processing is:
Name: ???

**Email:** ludus.auratus@gmail.com

___

### 9. Changes to this Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will take effect after publication on the website, and users will be notified in case of relevant updates.

___

descriptions.nicole: Nicole is the Product Owner of the team and acts as the main link between strategic vision and execution. Responsible for prioritizing demands, defining requirements, and ensuring that the product meets users’ needs, she leads development with a focus on value, clarity, and alignment with business objectives.
descriptions.kayque: Kayque serves as the Scrum Master and a Fullstack Developer, playing a key role in organizing agile processes and removing team impediments. In addition to facilitating communication and collaboration among members, he actively contributes to technical development, combining best practices in agile management and software engineering.
descriptions.matheus: Matheus is responsible for the financial area and also works as a Fullstack Developer. He handles financial planning, resource control, and project sustainability, while also contributing technically to the platform’s development, ensuring a balance between economic viability and technical quality.
descriptions.mizael: Mizael leads the Marketing strategies, being responsible for communication, brand positioning, and audience engagement. His work involves campaign creation, market analysis, and strengthening the project’s identity, bringing the solution closer to users and the market.
descriptions.pedro: Pedro works as a Fullstack Developer, contributing across different layers of the application with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability. His versatility allows him to efficiently integrate frontend and backend, supporting the team in building solid and well-structured solutions.
descriptions.gustavo: Gustavo is responsible for Backend and Database development, taking care of the architecture, security, and data integrity. His work ensures that systems are robust, efficient, and ready to scale, reliably supporting the entire platform operation.
descriptions.raquel: Raquel works on Frontend development and in the UI/UX area, being responsible for transforming complex functionalities into intuitive and enjoyable experiences. Her focus is on usability, accessibility, and user-centered design, ensuring that the interface is clear, modern, and efficient.
descriptions.ludus: Ludus is the platform’s artificial intelligence, developed to make the user experience simpler, more efficient, and personalized. Its primary function is to guide users through the site, assisting with navigation, explaining features, and providing clear and accessible contextual support. Additionally, Ludus acts as an intelligent game discovery engine, capable of interpreting natural language descriptions and identifying titles that best match the preferences, styles, and expectations provided by the user, seamlessly connecting technology and experience.

approval_time.question: How long does it take for my game to be approved?
approval_time.answer: Our review process takes an average of 24 to 48 business hours. We check technical aspects, content, and overall quality. You will receive detailed feedback if there is anything to adjust.

platform_exclusivity.question: Can I publish my game on other platforms as well?
platform_exclusivity.answer: Yes! We do not require exclusivity. You are free to publish your game wherever you want. We only recommend that you keep your games updated on all platforms.

acceptable_games.question: What kind of games are accepted on Ludus?
acceptable_games.answer: We accept indie games of various genres, according to our terms of publication, as long as they are developed by Brazilians or contain Brazilian cultural elements. We prioritize quality, originality, and gameplay.

cnpj_requirement.question: Do I need a CNPJ (corporate tax ID) to sell games?
cnpj_requirement.answer: Not necessarily. For individual developers, we accept CPF (individual tax ID). However, for higher amounts, we recommend having MEI or CNPJ due to tax issues.

marketing_help.question: Do you help with marketing and promotion?
marketing_help.answer: Yes! All games receive basic promotion on our social media channels. Games of exceptional quality may be featured on the homepage and at special events.

update_publishing.question: Can I update my game after it's published?
update_publishing.answer: Yes! You can make as many updates as you want, at no additional cost. Just upload the new version through the developer panel. We only remind you that every post, even updates, goes through our security team.
